claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SCH-58261 is a selective A2A adenosine receptor antagonist with no reported direct cytotoxicity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any killing likely reflecting weak non-specific effects rather than a shared cytotoxic mechanism.
